book: Agrawal ExamCart, SSB OIR, Reasoning section
scans: SSR OIR 1-127 (phone photos of printed pages 1-127)
title: Cubes and Dice
note: Dice and nets are redrawn (D29): a view lists its top face and the faces drawn on the left and right of the corner; a net lists its squares. Pips are pips:N; a black face is fill, a crossed face cross, a blank face "". Only which mark is on which face is kept, not which way up a mark is drawn. Typos kept ("oppositge", "intechanged", "oppsite", "pane", "Are"; Q11 offers "In", not on the die, and prints NO for No). Q54-71 share the printed direction; Q54-59 print it on page 72. Q65 and Q66 print no question of their own under that direction; their stem says what is asked. Where the printed options are drawings, each option is also described in words.

directions.text: Which of the following answer figure can be formed by folding the figure given in the question?
